title: The Interior of the reservoir
author: Elodie Kavanagh
blurb: Rafael Ishikawa, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
